title: Expected subset intersection size
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Weight each subset $J$ of the coordinate set by $\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$. Then $\sum_J \delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}|U\cap J|=\delta|U|$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For
each subset $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, give it weight
$\delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}$. Then the weighted sum of the intersection sizes
satisfies $\sum_J \delta^{|J|}(1-\delta)^{n-|J|}|U\cap J|=\delta|U|$.
